profile.headline: SWE @ Facebook
profile.summary:
Distributed systems engineer with focus on low level distributed storage. I enjoy working on impactful problems with like-minded people.

In addition to software engineering, I serve on the board of Club Northwest, a nonprofit that develops track and field, road racing, and cross country from youth to Olympic level in the Pacific Northwest.

Public works: nuclide.io — getfreshspired.com — openscience.us — lecturepulse.com
Specialties: Distributed systems, storage infrastructure
Languages: C++, Python, Javascript, PHP/Hack, Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Distributed block storage - tiering, cloud expansion, release stability, overall reliability

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built features for internet-scale distributed storage system such as distributed cache shard migrations, and write routing optimizations.
- Designed & shipped data loss detection pipeline with 1-in-1-trillion detection sensitivity. Uncovered core MySQL leader failover bug.
- Shipped efficiency savings of ~$5mil/year and ~3 petabytes/year.
- Built debug tooling for internal video upload failures to help engineers quickly diagnose reliability and quality issues.

I left the company to pursue a masters degree full time.

Skills: Distributed systems, data engineering, full stack

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- 2017 Internship: Shipped new service health monitoring infrastructure to improve reliability of internal CI platform.
- 2016 Internship: Shipped new “Context View” feature for Facebook’s IDE, Nuclide: nuclide.io/docs/features/context-view

positions.title: Undergraduate Research
positions.description:
- Built and trained models to predict time-to-close for open source software issue reports.
- Set the highest model performance yet achieved on this problem. Wrote the paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.07735
- Used decision tree classifiers, pruning, feature selectors, oversampling & model evaluation techniques, statistical analysis (significance, effect size).

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Led backend development for Freshspire, a startup building an online marketplace for sourcing local food. Shipped MVP backend API.

Server stack: Linux/Tomcat/MySQL/Java, hosted on AWS.
Frameworks used: Spring, Hibernate, JUnit, Mockito, Authy client, SLF4J

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Built & patented novel visualization to better inform and personalize cancer treatment decisions
- Implemented AngularJS & Bootstrap frontend, Node.js & Express.js backend
- Worked as sprint manager on an independent intern team using Agile development practices

positions.title: Developer & Curator @ OpenScience
positions.description:
- Shipped new website for OpenScience, a research dataset hosting service aimed at making research more reproducible. Site: http://openscience.us/repo
- New site increased voluntary dataset submissions from 0 per month to ~10 per month, saving approx. 40 hours/month of manual work.

Source code: https://github.com/opensciences/opensciences.github.io

company.name: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics

honors.title: University Honors Program Member
honors.description: Member of a competitive academic research program encouraging academic inquiry and curiosity. Each member maintains high academic achievement, takes cross-disciplinary seminars, and completes a substantial senior year Capstone research project.
honors.issuer: Issued by NCSU University Honors Program · Aug 2014

honors.title: NCHSAA 2A Cross Country State Champions
honors.description: Served as team captain for the 2013 2A state champion cross country team.

volunteerExperiences.description: Board member for prominent track & field nonprofit. Currently focusing on athletic development ecosystems in the Seattle area. Developed community track meet to one of the largest and most successful in the nation. Strengthened partnerships with sponsor companies/organizations for teams and races/events.

projects.title: LecturePulse
projects.description: An education-tech software platform designed to help professors deliver more effective lectures at scale.

projects.title: iTrust - CSC326 project
projects.description:
Best (winning) implementation of iTrust, a medical application built over many semesters as a team project by students in CSC326 Software Engineering. Our project was selected as best-of-the-semester on the criteria of UI/UX quality, code quality, architecture improvements, and documentation.

Tech stack: Apache/MySQL/JavaServer Faces, JUnit/Mockito/Cucumber for testing

Learning Outcomes:
- Agile Development
- Git, GitHub, pull request workflow
- Project planning and project management
- Databases
- Design patterns

Team:
Michael Mackrell: QA Leader, Documentation Leader
Mitch Rees-Jones: Lead Designer & Architect
Nathan Miles: Back-end Development Leader
Thomas Ortiz: Front-end Development leader
James Miao: Team Leader, Planning Leader
